name: Graft
notes: Turn a structured idea into a recommended integration patch for THIS workshop as it actually is. Graft reads the live spine, module set, layers and verify count, finds conflicts (taken ids, missing capabilities, version disagreements, and anything touching the spine — always refused), and produces an ordered plan with a check before and after each step. A patch is a route with a fingerprint: it goes STALE if the workshop changes under it. A patch is DATA, never code — v0.1 produces a plan for a human to inspect, cross-check and build. It never applies anything, and it reports what it could not examine. A graft that does not take fails visibly rather than poisoning the host.
